notes: Batch B06 compiled 2026-09-25 under a 12-search / 2-fetch budget; both WebFetch attempts (company sites) were blocked by the egress proxy, so no primary documents were read in full - all facts come from search-result summaries of press releases, SEC exhibits, trade press and NGA/NRO coverage, plus clearly labeled RECALL. Cross-cutting findings: (1) NRO moved commercial SAR (Umbra, Capella/IonQ, ICEYE US - RCA, Aug 2026) and commercial RF (HawkEye 360 - CRFCA, Aug 2026) from multi-year study contracts into operational augmentation contracts with undisclosed (classified-budget) values; (2) EOCL (EO layer, ~$4B/10yr from May 2022) faced 2025 proposals to cut program funding from ~$300M/yr to ~$200M/yr with Planet and BlackSky most exposed - FY2026 appropriations outcome not verified this session (Public evidence insufficient); (3) NGA Luno A ($290M ceiling, 10 vendors, Sept 2024) and Luno B ($200M cap, 13 vendors, 2025) are the main analytics IDIQs - verified awardees in this batch: BlackSky (A and B), Maxar Intelligence/Vantor (A) and Maxar Mission Solutions (B), Planet Labs Federal (B); Umbra, Capella and HawkEye 360 participation not verified (partial lists only). Traction: HawkEye 360 IPO (May 2026, $416M raised, ~$2.4B) and Planet (Q2 FY27 revenue $116M, backlog ~$815M, D&I ~70%) show the strongest commercial-sensing demand signals; BlackSky reached positive adjusted EBITDA with Gen-3 subscriptions; Vantor converted OWT to a $217M-ceiling production OTA; Hidden Level jumped from STTR/APFIT to a $100M OTA. Data gaps: contract obligations vs ceilings for nearly all awards; Umbra and Hidden Level funding/investors/headcount; Capella acquisition close value; Planet's 2026 DoD/Navy award details; BlackSky FY2025 revenue; HawkEye Q2 2026 figures; TacSRT and Global Data Marketplace order values. Implication for founders: this batch sits almost entirely at COLLECT (space/passive sensors) with vendor-specific PROCESS platforms; whitespace for a small software team is in multi-vendor tasking/orchestration, cross-sensor tipping-and-cueing and delivery into tactical-echelon C2 rather than in owning sensors - but absence of competitors is not evidence of demand and foreign-national founders face ITAR/FOCI constraints on ISR data work that require specialist legal review.
